steps.text: Go to Shadowthorn, the elf town in the swamp south-east of Venore.
steps.source: Find your way to Shadowthorn and enter the hole here.

steps.text: Go down the trapdoor south-west of the town (elves).
steps.source: Find your way to Shadowthorn and enter the hole here (Mapper Coords 129.36, 125.182, 7).

steps.text: Head west (elf scouts) and go down the ramp.
steps.source: When you come down, head west.

steps.text: Down the ramp: elf arcanists, elf scouts and ghouls. The three chests are at the north end of the room; the west one: a crystal ball.
steps.source: Down the ramp you will find 4 Elf Arcanists, at least 4 Elf Scouts, two Ghouls and one Demon Skeleton. The three quest boxes are located in the north end of this room.

steps.text: The middle chest: the time ring.
steps.source: The three quest boxes are located in the north end of this room.

steps.text: The east chest: an elven amulet.
steps.source: The three quest boxes are located in the north end of this room.
